verdict.rationale: Docs show Bugbot automatically reviews every PR update (including those opened by Cloud Agents themselves), scans diffs for bugs/security/quality issues, supports manual triggers, and offers configurable effort levels for deeper reviews at scale across GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Azure DevOps. Community reports (mixed) corroborate it catching genuine bugs missed by human reviewers, though some users note occasional frivolous/wrong comments and one incident of it reversing its own fix suggestion — caveats on accuracy rather than contradictions of its volume-review capability. Missing for 10: independent quantitative benchmarks on catch-rate/scale specifically for AI-generated code, and stronger resolution of mixed community accuracy feedback.
